// Fixture: the pre-correction text of the two comments on the
// adapter→gateway event stream in schemas/lenny-adapter.proto. The RPC
// comment credits the stream with the four intra-pod CH-RUNTIMEOPS frames
// and sends the reader to §15.4; the envelope comment names
// lenny-adapter-jsonl.schema.json as the taxonomy's owner.

  // AdapterEvents is a bidirectional stream the adapter uses to surface
  // Full-level lifecycle events (checkpoint_ready, interrupt_acknowledged,
  // credentials_acknowledged, deadline_approaching). See spec §15.4 for
  // the event taxonomy.
  rpc AdapterEvents(stream AdapterEventsRequest) returns (stream AdapterEventsResponse) {}

// Opaque lifecycle event envelope. The lifecycle event taxonomy is defined
// in lenny-adapter-jsonl.schema.json under the lifecycle section in the
// spec. Kept opaque here so the proto schema does not need to evolve every
// time a lifecycle event is added. Request and response carry the same
// payload but are typed separately per proto-RPC convention.
message AdapterEventsRequest {
  bytes envelope_json = 1;
}
